title: Samsung Note 10+ Update
symptom: After a Samsung update (ui2.0), the phone and Miaomiao transmitter will no longer communicate.
fix: Uncheck almost every Bluetooth option in the Xdrip Bluetooth menu except the first one ('Turn Bluetooth on if switched off'), reset the Miaomiao, and completely shut down and restart the phone.
settings_changed: Turn Bluetooth on if switched off → checked (only one checked)
evidence_quote: almost every Bluetooth option needs to be unchecked in the Xdrip Bluetooth menu with the exception of the very first one which is 'Turn Bluetooth on if switched off'
